name: New Mexico 4-H
what_you_do: Pick projects like livestock, robots, cooking or public speaking. Join a club in your county with adult volunteers.
who_can_apply: New Mexico youth in rural, suburban and urban areas. The age range is not filled in on the page. Ask your county office.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 enrollment year is open. Deadlines vary by county.
how_to_apply: Find your county Extension office. Then make a family account and join at 4h.zsuite.org. Each member sends a sign-up form and a liability form each year.
notes: State office phone on the page is 575-646-3026. Ages and fees were left as placeholders on the page.
